acceptance_test_matrix: Positive semantic coverage: equities.relativeVolumeZ.v1 fixture round-trips propose, validate, compile to FeatureNode primitives, R-015 backtest, operator promote, catalog/get retrieval, archive, and live ranking contribution.

Validator edge-case coverage: unknown op, unknown ref, cyclic transform, missing required field, unknown apiVersion, malformed YAML, duplicate signal version, stale promote/archive request, invalid lifecycle transition, invariant failure, and partial backtest failure all produce actionable diagnostics and preserve lifecycle invariants.

API persistence coverage: one row per SignalSpec version plus exact YAML body; archive/promote are lifecycle transitions; invalid proposals cannot compile, backtest, promote, or rank; promoted records expose author, signalId, signalVersion, proposalId, and trackRecord.

Lifecycle and concurrency coverage: operator approval metadata is required, stale proposalId/signalVersion writes fail, retry is idempotent, duplicate live rows are prevented, and archive removes live contribution without deleting catalog history.
UI coverage: catalog/review page renders author, lifecycle status, validator diagnostics, YAML, trackRecord, and explicit operator confirmation for promote/archive.
Configured QA gate coverage: targeted unit/API/UI tests pass, then ./qa/smoke.sh and ./qa/regression.sh pass as final gates.
assumptions: specs/SIGNAL_SPEC.md is the frozen source of truth for SignalSpec v1 schema, op vocabulary, lifecycle, validator diagnostics, and API semantics.
R-015 backtest APIs and deterministic replay path already exist and must be reused rather than duplicated.
SignalSpec v1 is declarative only; Java signal code generation is explicitly out of scope.
Promotion to live requires explicit human/operator approval through the API/UI and must never occur automatically after validation, compilation, or backtest success.

SignalSpec persistence must use an approved control-plane persistence boundary; app-api must not directly write Redis or the historical store unless repo-memory/DECISIONS.md records a narrow ownership exception before implementation.
UI contract changes preserve the existing React/TypeScript test expectations and expose additive provenance fields without breaking existing opportunity consumers.

design_contract.concurrency_protocol: SignalSpec promotion and archive operations must be idempotent, version-checked, and reject stale proposals or conflicting active versions with actionable diagnostics; compile/backtest/promote must use immutable proposal identifiers so partial approvals cannot race into live ranking.
forbidden_alternatives: Generating Java classes or source files from SignalSpec definitions.
Adding Postgres, SQLite, Prisma, Drizzle, or another OLTP layer for SignalSpec state.
Letting UI write directly to the historical store or Redis.
Promoting signals automatically after successful validation or backtest.
Implementing a separate backtest engine instead of calling R-015.
Silently accepting unknown apiVersion, unknown operations, unknown references, or transform cycles.
hard_constraints: Do not add Java code generation for signals.
Do not allow auto-promotion without human/operator approval.
Reuse the R-015 backtest path for all SignalSpec backtests.
Validator must reject unknown op, unknown ref, cyclic transform, missing required field, and unknown apiVersion with actionable diagnostics.
app-api must respect the Redis hot-view and historical-store ownership decision; any new persistence must be through the approved SignalSpec persistence boundary.
Promoted SignalSpecs must carry author provenance into opportunity explainability and live ranking contribution.
design_contract.ownership_boundaries: platform-dsl owns SignalSpec parsing, validation, cycle detection, diagnostics, and compilation to existing FeatureNode primitives; app-api owns HTTP contracts and operator approval workflow but must not become an ad hoc database writer outside the approved SignalSpec persistence adapter; UI owns catalog/provenance rendering; R-015 owns backtest execution.
design_contract.persistence_protocol: Persist one metadata row per SignalSpec proposal plus the canonical YAML body, preserving author provenance, proposalId, signalId, signalVersion, status, validation diagnostics, backtest trackRecord, approval actor/time, archive state, and stale/invalid status transitions.
design_contract.public_api: Add versioned SignalSpec DSL support for apiVersion-known YAML specs and REST endpoints under /api/signals for propose, catalog, get, promote, and archive; opportunities must expose author, signalId, signalVersion, proposalId, and trackRecord when a promoted signal contributes to ranking.
